main.description: Return the ordered post references selected by an Acorn-owned space-backed feed. The feed is named by its ordinary public app.bsky.feed.generator URI; the records live in a permissioned space and their URIs are plain strings rather than at-uris.

feed.description: The public feed-generator record bound to the space feed.

did.description: The authenticated viewer DID asserted by the trusted AppView caller.

errors.name: MembershipRequired
errors.description: The asserted viewer is not authorised to view this active space feed.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The feed is not an active space-backed feed or a parameter is invalid.
